citation.title: Physics-based integrated modeling of the energy confinement time scaling laws for the H- and L-modes in the KSTAR-type tokamak model
citation.authors: J.Y. Kim, H.S. Han, L. Terzolo

topic: Integrated transport modeling (ASTRA with GLF23/MMM, plus EPED1) of global confinement scaling. Uses a KSTAR-type model with R=1.74 m, a=0.48 m.
own_question: How do marginal-stability, turbulent and pedestal contributions produce the empirical stored-energy scaling with IP, Pin, BT and ne?
actual_method_and_evidence: Simulation-only parameter scans. Stored energy is split into a marginal part, extrapolated to low power, and a turbulent part. The pedestal is set by EPED1 and iterated with the core to capture core-edge coupling. No experimental CES, BES or ECEI data is used. There is no time-resolved or causal analysis, and the work does not address diagnostics or nowcasting.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: In integrated modeling of a KSTAR-type H-mode, the core temperature profile is strongly tied to the pedestal-top boundary through profile stiffness.
claim_checks.qualification: This is a modeling result under GLF23 and EPED1 assumptions with a prescribed density profile. It is not a measurement and is not specific to impurity Ti.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Not applicable. The paper treats steady-state profiles and has no measurement timing.
validation_if_relevant: Calculated scaling exponents are compared with the empirical IPB98 and ITER89 laws only. No data split is involved.
forbidden_inferences: That pedestal-top CES Ti is predictable from BES or ECEI signals
That this paper validates any KSTAR 2022 measurement
That the stiffness exponents apply to carbon-impurity CES temperature dynamics
reason_to_include_or_exclude: The paper is at most optional background on why pedestal-top temperature matters for global confinement. It provides no diagnostic, timing or estimator evidence relevant to our nowcasting question.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
